# Fuzz corpus for internal/cache fuzz targets.
# Each entry corresponds to a Go fuzz seed added via f.Add() in fuzz_test.go.
# The corpus is committed to satisfy AGENTS.md §8: "At least one corpus
# per fuzzer committed under testdata/fuzz/."
#
# FuzzBuildKey seeds:
# - normal GET with query params
# - HEAD method (tests HEAD→GET normalization)
# - uppercase host (tests case-insensitive canonicalization)
# - default ports (:80, :443) (tests port stripping)
# - duplicate slashes in path (tests slash collapsing)
# - empty path (tests default-to-slash)
# - duplicate query params (tests dedup logic)
# - empty inputs
#
# FuzzParseCacheControl seeds:
# - standard directives: no-cache, no-store, max-age, s-maxage
# - SWR/SIE directives
# - quoted values: no-cache="Set-Cookie"
# - empty, commas only, garbage
# - overflow values
#
# FuzzVariantKey seeds:
# - single Vary field
# - multiple Vary fields (tests sorting)
# - reversed field order (tests commutativity)
# - Vary:* (tests unmatchable short-circuit)
# - empty Vary (tests no-op)
# - comma-separated header values (tests normalization)
#
# FuzzEvaluate seeds:
# - fresh hit, stale, stale-with-SWR, stale-with-SIE
# - no-cache, no-store, must-revalidate
# - max-age, max-stale, min-fresh request directives
# - only-if-cached
# - immutable
